query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='wso2/identity-anonymization-tool' AND number=60 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Executing the anonymization tool several time result in generating log files with multiple "temp.txt" extensions
data.body:
**Description**:
Running the tool for multiple times creates the log fixes with multiple "temp.txt" extensions

**Affected Product Version**:
EI 6.1.1 update 23

**OS, DB, other environment details and versions**:
OS - ubuntu 15.10
DB - mysql 5.6
JDK - 1.8

Pre- Requisites
PII information exists in the logs

**Steps to reproduce**:
1. Execute the tool to replace the user information (ex: ./forget-me.sh -U peter)
2. Without removing the log files execute the tool again (ex: ./forget-me.sh -U sam)

**Observations**
This will create another the set of temp log files with "temp.txt" extension

**Expected Behaviour**
The tool should be handled in a way to not execute set of temp log files if that particular username does not exist in the logs.
Since we can not handle the behaviour of a user using the tool, we should make sure not to create another set of log files with the extension.

![screenshot from 2018-03-12 11-13-05](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14962228/37267448-5f393424-25e6-11e8-8996-8cb4fc77fa26.png)

Refer - https://github.com/wso2/product-ei/issues/1967
